title: Investments in Associates and Joint Ventures
summary: Prescribes the equity method of accounting for investments in associates and joint ventures and the significant influence test, converged almost exactly with IAS 28.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS — Closely Converged with IAS 28
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 28 reproduces IAS 28's equity method mechanics and significant influence test almost exactly, with no substantive divergence. Its Indian practical relevance is prominent given the widespread use of joint venture/associate structures in Indian conglomerates and infrastructure groups. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
